Land Titles (Strata) Act
(Chapter 158, Section 6(3))
Notifications under Section 6(3)
N 1
G.N. No. S 136/1968
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
The Minister for National Development has specified that the provisions of section 6 of the Act shall not apply to the following buildings or class of buildings:
(1)to any flat forming part of a building shown in a subdivision plan approved by the Competent Authority as constituting a building unit of two flats;
[S 136/68]
[5.5.68]
(2)to flats on subdivided buildings controlled, managed and administered by the Port of Singapore Authority;
[S 56/74]
[22.2.74]
(3)to flats comprised in the buildings known as Orchard Court erected on the land known as Lot 227 Town Subdivision 20;
[S 299/74]
[25.10.74]
(4)[Revoked by S 137/82 wef 01/05/1982]
(5)to flats comprised in the buildings known as Neptune Court erected on the land known as Lot 4571 Mukim XXVII;
[S 150/77]
[17.6.77]
(6)to flats comprised in the buildings erected in the housing estate known as Normanton Park on the land known as Lot 1334 Mukim III;
[S 189/77]
[29.7.77]
(7)to any flat comprised in the building known as Lagoon View erected on the land known as Lot 4628 Mukim XXVII;
[S 49/78]
[17.3.78]
(8)to any flat comprised in the building known as Cavenagh Townhouse erected on the land known as Lot 490 of Town Subdivision 27; and
[S 65/78]
[31.3.78]
(9)to any flat comprised in any building erected on the land known as Lot 1239 of Town Subdivision 17.
[S 246/78]
[20.10.78]
